description: Resume a paused Company Search or Company Enrich task and return its updated status. Free. The task continues from where it stopped, keeping the companies already delivered, with no new charge. Works only on a paused task, within 7 days of pausing; a task in any other state, including one the API cancelled after 7 days paused, returns 409. Poll company-search-status for the new companies.

task_id.description: task_id returned by company-search or company-enrich, example: '5b33f3ee-168b-4780-9c8e-63a626781872'. A People Search task_id is not found here.

name: company-search-resume
title: Resume Company Search
